name: dashboard-hero
title: Dashboard hero
description: A SaaS opening with the product drawn in HTML: the pitch on the left, a cropped dashboard with KPIs and a table on the right.
docs: Pass title, primary (a label and an href), and optionally eyebrow, description and secondary. The window prop draws the product: a title for its bar, nav (labels, or labels with an icon; a label alone gets a quiet dot) with activeNav, three kpis (a label, a value and how it changed), and rows for the table, each with a name, a status word and an optional tone, detail and amount (the amount column is drawn when the picture is at least 36rem wide). The window runs off the right and bottom edges of its stage so it reads as a bigger product, follows light and dark because it is real markup, and is hidden and inert, with one sentence for screen readers made from its own figures (or your summary). Under 1024px it sits below the copy, still cropped.
